synthesizedFacts.fact: Wrinkles the Clown is a 2019 American documentary comedy horror film directed by Michael Beach Nichols.
The film explores the urban phenomenon of Wrinkles the Clown, a character parents can hire to scare their children.
Wrinkles the Clown is a character created by an unidentified performance artist as part of an art project.
The film was released in the United States on October 4, 2019.
